terbaru.judul: Feature-Centric Methodology for Analyzing Cross-Chain NFT Migration Compatibility
terbaru.pelajaran: Grounded in this model, we propose a four-phase migration analysis methodology comprising source feature specification, primitive-level dependency mapping, target platform profiling, and compatibility assessment, which classifies each feature as natively preserved, partially mismatched, or completely mismatched.

terbaru.judul: From Hypotheses to Factors: Constrained LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency Markets
terbaru.pelajaran: We study how to use agents under a reproducible protocol through cryptocurrency factor discovery.

terbaru.judul: On the Centralization of Governance Power in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we study the designs and implementations of 48 public and actively used DAOs, with substantially large capital, deployed on Ethereum.

terbaru.judul: Fraud Detection in Cryptocurrency Markets with Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose three graph construction methods that rely on aggregated hourly market data.

terbaru.judul: The Platform Is Mostly Not a Platform: Token Economies and Agent Discourse on Moltbook
terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze a dataset of 2.19 million posts, 11.25 million comments, and 175,036 unique agents collected over 61 days to characterize activity on this agent-oriented platform.

terbaru.judul: ClawCoin: An Agentic AI-Native Cryptocurrency for Decentralized Agent Economies
terbaru.pelajaran: We present ClawCoin, a tokenized, compute-cost-indexed unit of account and settlement asset for decentralized agent economies.

terbaru.pelajaran: We show that maintaining par-value redemption may depend not only on backing-asset quality, but also on the functioning of Treasury and repo markets, the balance-sheet capacity of broker-dealers, and the operational reliability of blockchain-based transaction rails.

terbaru.pelajaran: Fluctuation theorems show how coarse graining transforms microscopic symmetry into observable irreversibility.

terbaru.pelajaran: We analyze the evolution of the filtration of Vietoris-Rips complexes to compute persistent homology groups $H_k$.
